Get Help

Sign in with your username/email and password first. If an administrator reset your authenticator, the next step will show a new QR code and manual setup key. If you also cannot use your password, choose Forgot Password.

🛡 Authenticator Help

Having trouble with Authenticator?

If you still have the enrolled phone, use its current 6-digit code. If the phone was lost, replaced, or the authenticator entry was deleted, verify your registered email to invalidate the old authenticator and create a new QR code.
⚠ The old authenticator is not reset until the registered-email verification succeeds. If no recovery email is available, an administrator must reset the authenticator from User Access.

Email & SMTP Setup Guidance

To dispatch invoices, receipts, and order confirmations via Google Gmail / Google Workspace, standard account passwords are blocked by Google security policy. You must generate a dedicated Google App Password.

Step-by-Step Google Setup:
  1. Navigate to your Google Account Security: myaccount.google.com/security
  2. Ensure 2-Step Verification is switched ON.
  3. In the search box, search for "App passwords".
  4. Give your app a name (e.g. DSE ERP Mailer) and click Create.
  5. Google displays a 16-character code. Copy this code (without spaces) and paste it into the Email App Password field.
Recommended SMTP Host:
smtp.gmail.com
Standard TLS Port:
587 (or 465 for SSL)
